entries.title: Fresh start: $1,000 cash; strategy set with Vamsi
entries.body:
Round 1 is closed and archived in archive/round1/free/ (ledger, journal, config, watchlist). This book restarts at $1,000 cash with no positions.
Finish line: the Mon Oct 5, 4:00 PM ET close unless Vamsi sets a new window.
Strategy: Vamsi is setting it. No position until it is in place; every trade gets a journal entry that cites the rule it follows.
